how_to_apply: Download the blank application form for engagement of FTA- Hindi Translator Gr III from the BHEL website at https://careers.bhel.in.
Fill out the application form carefully and affix a self-attested passport-size photograph.
Gather photocopies of all required certificates and documents.

Submit the filled-in application form by post to DGM (HR), BHEL Corp. R&D HRM Dept., Ground Floor, Administrative Building, BHEL Corp. R&D Vikas Nagar, Hyderabad, 500093 along with a copy of the required documents.
Alternatively, send the scanned application and documents by email with the subject FTA -HINDI TRANSLATOR GRIII to [email protected] on or before 23.10.2026.

Attend the walk-in interview on 22.10.2026 at 11:30 AM at BHEL Corp. R&D, Vikas Nagar, Balanagar, Hyderabad - 500093, carrying the original application form, original certificates, and one copy of self-attested photocopies.
important_instructions: Self-declaration for character and antecedents is required at the time of joining. Selected candidates must undergo a medical examination by the company's authorized medical officer or government officer and meet prescribed health standards. The appointment is purely on a temporary basis for two years and shall not confer any right for regular employment in BHEL. There is a notice period of one month on either side for discontinuing the engagement. Working hours will be a maximum of eight hours a day for six days a week. Candidates attending the interview will not be paid any TA/DA. Employed candidates in Govt/Semi-Govt/PSU/Autonomous bodies must apply through proper channel.
